lines.en: I hop through the marsh.
Water splashes when I land.
I shift along the river beach.
I hop slowly your way.
I step over lily pads.
I wade through the shallows.
I crouch and spring.
Webbed feet crunch over riverbank gravel.
I hop along the water's edge.
I squat, my cheeks puffing.
My two eyes are big and round.
I hold still by the water.
I wait for a bug to fly past.
I blink slowly.
I pull my head in a little.
My skin is wet and shiny.
I rest on a leaf.
I squat on a lily pad, waiting for bugs.
I hum very low.
My eyes roll slowly.
I take a slow breath and puff up.
I rub my feet on the leaf.
I raise my round face to you.
I tilt my head, cheeks puffed.
I am guessing your weight.
Frogmon's webbed foot shifts a step.
My frog eyes don't blink; I'm waiting for flies.
You are standing at the water's edge.
I open my mouth at you.
First I listen to your splashing steps.
My toes grip the ground.
I will not yield half a step.
I set my head straight and look.
You move and I hop aside.
I slowly shift back.
I blink once at you.
I hop a little closer.
I hop half a block away.
My cheeks deflate.
I squat very low.
I make a short sound.
I shift one step toward the water.
I shake my whole body.
I stare at you without moving.
A mark shows on my skin.
I slowly set myself straight.
I hop toward that thing.
I look at it for two seconds.

lines.zh: 把它推到旁边，黏糊糊的。
lines.en: Pushing it aside — sticky.
I look up for one more.
I squat and eat slowly.
I press it into the wet ground.
I sniff and hop away.
I hop back once.
I squat beside it, still.

lines.zh: 我把它卷到嘴里又吐出。
lines.en: I take it and spit it out.
You bump me and I spring a block.
I bounce once off the ground.
We splash water up.
I land back, steady.
I shift my body aside.
We land one wet smack.
I am not flustered at all.
I squat back down.

lines.zh: 两只青蛙蹲在同一片叶上。
lines.en: Two frogs squat on the same leaf.
Our cheeks puff in turn.
I touch its toe.
Its call follows mine.
Our eyes meet.
Neither of us stirs.
We blink slowly together.
Their heads rest together.
I hold it against my chest.
I hop twice dragging it.
I press it onto a stone.
Wet hands can't hold this seed.
I stuff it into the reeds.
I lift it up and look.
I drop it into the water.
I squat holding it.
It is a bit bigger than me.
I squat low and hold.
I am fixed on that movement.
My cheeks puff out.
My toes dig in.
I have picked the shortest route.
I will not squat and wait.
I can reach this distance.
I close in bit by bit.
I quicken my pace forward.
I follow it hop by hop.
It moves and I turn.
I hold this gap the whole time.
I cross along the water.
I am two hops away.
I squat and gather myself.
I stay at its rear flank.
I edge closer bit by bit.
No hurry; I leap far.
I have blocked one of its routes.
My tongue lashes out and catches it.
My tongue shoots out faster than my jump.
I drop my whole body down on you.
I butt its middle.
It is pressed into the mud.
I give it a hard kick.
I hop again and add a blow.
It backs off; I hop after.
Water splashes its face.
I squat, load, and hit again.
A round head appears at the water's edge.
I hop out of the reeds.
A line of toe prints appears in the mud.
I begin hopping through the marsh.

lines.zh: 你听见一声闷闷的落水。
lines.en: You hear a dull splash.
There is one on a leaf now.
I squat on a stone and watch.
My eyes show first.
I slowly come up out of the water.
I begin shifting this way.
A ring spreads on the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水还挂在我背上。
lines.en: Swamp water still clings to my back.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的皮肤，我跳进水里。
lines.en: Fire touches my skin and I hop into the water.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸在石头上。
lines.en: I drop from a height onto stone.
I choke once in the water.
The blast flips me over.
The arrow sticks in my webbing. It hurts.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我钉在地上。
lines.en: That force nails me down.
Hunger shortens my hops.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我一下僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 下面的水一空，我就掉了。
lines.en: The water below gave way and I fell.
